content.title: Festivals Commission
content.summary: The Arvada Festivals Commission (AFC) organizes various community events, including Winterfest, the Kite Festival, Summerfest, High Tea for Seniors, and Movies Around Town, aimed at fostering community spirit and celebration. The commission consists of 25 volunteer members who must be Arvada residents and are required to actively participate in meetings and events. Recruitment for new members occurs in December, with specific attendance and participation requirements outlined for those interested in joining.
content.body:
## Overview

The Arvada Festivals Commission (AFC) sponsors, coordinates and plans events that bring the Arvada community together in celebration.

AFC-sponsored events include:

### [**Arvada Winterfest**](/496)

Winterfest is a culturally driven family event with games, performances, music, vendors, food and drinks. The event is held annually in February in Olde Town.

### [**Arvada Kite Festival**](/1245)

The Kite Festival is a Arvada's flagship community event featuring kites of all shapes and sizes. The free, all-ages event is held annually in April at Stenger Sports Complex.

### [**Arvada Summerfest**](/1261)

Arvada Summerfest is Arvada's premier summer kick-off festival celebrating the local community. Summerfest started in 2025 and is held annually in June at Ralston Park Addition.

### [**High Tea for Seniors**](/1199)

High Tea for Seniors is AFC's beloved senior celebration that includes tasty food, elegant desserts and tea served from fancy and unique teapots. The event is held annually in August at the Apex Community Recreation Center.

### [**Movies Around Town**](/1260)

Movies Around Town features free movie on a giant inflatable movie screen at different parks each month throughout the summer.

Arvada Festivals Commission members participate as active volunteers in putting together current festivals and events as well as helping to create new ones for the Arvada community.

Members are expected to be active in the Commission and participate in meetings and events. It is important for the success of the Festivals Commission that the members have the desire, willingness, and time to devote to Commission planning and events. We are a group that takes great pride in what we have accomplished and we look forward to even greater things for our city in the future.

## Board Details

- 25 members
- 3 year terms
- Volunteer appointment
- Must be an Arvada resident to serve
- Background check required
- Commission members must
  - Attend at least 7 of 11 monthly meetings each year
  - Help plan at least 2 Commission events by attending sub-committee meetings for these events
  - Volunteer to work and actively take part on the day of at least two additional Commission events
  - Maintain and submit Commission documentation as necessary (volunteer hours, budgets, sub-committee meeting notes, etc.)

## Interested in Joining the Festivals Commission?

Recruitment to fill vacancies on boards and commissions will begin in December. You can review the application process on the main [Boards, Commissions and Committees page](/248/Boards-Commissions-and-Committees).
